title: $\mathrm{SL}_N$ Quantum-Torus Summands and Visible Nielsen Numbers
summary: Let $M_γ=T^2\times_γS^1$, where $γ\in\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{Z})$ is hyperbolic. For every $N\geq2$, we compute the empty-skein, or quantum-torus, direct summand in Kinnear's decomposition of the $\mathrm{SL}_N$-skein module of $M_γ$, thereby answering his centralizer question for this summand in the hyperbolic case. Its dimension is expressed in terms of the periodic Nielsen numbers $N_k=|\det(I-γ^k)|$ and the visible Nielsen numbers $V_{e\mathbb{Z}^2}(f_γ)$ carried by torsion in the Weyl coinvariant lattices.
